diagnostics.nodeCheck: exit=0 on all .mjs files (env.mjs, bootstrap.mjs, runner.mjs)

malformed_input.result: Unknown mode → exit 1 with error; non-numeric hold-ms → exit 1; missing --root still works for print-env/lock-probe (root-optional commands)

stale_state.result: Warm mode: exit 1 with live-e2e-fingerprint-mismatch; cold mode: removes old state, rebuilds fresh fingerprint

classes: git status --porcelain shows uncommitted files → fingerprint.gitDirty=true
dirty_worktree.reason: Verified the gitDirty field exists and defaults to true for dirty worktrees. Fingerprint mismatch check compares gitDirty; if the only change is tests adding files, warm mode will see stale git dirty mismatch. This is correct behavior: fingerprint change forces a cold rebuild when the checkout changes.

classes: print-env --json exits 0 only for real env
misleading_success_output.result: Exit codes match the documented contract. Warm mode with stale fingerprint exits 1. Cold mode always exits 0 (fingerprint written fresh). Unbootstrapped root exits 1 regardless of mode.

hung/long_commands.result: Hold uses spawnSync('sleep', ...) which blocks the process without blocking the host system. Release happens after sleep exits. Tested with parallel contention.

classes: Two concurrent lock-probe --hold-ms 1000 for same repo
concurrent_lock.result: Exactly one acquires (exit 0), one reports held (exit 1 with live-e2e-lock-held). Lock directory is removed after both exit.

unbootstrapped_root.result: exit 1 with live-e2e-root-not-bootstrapped for both warm and cold modes

classes: One process writes PID file while another reads it → 'pid unknown'
race_condition_lock_file_write.reason: Minor diagnostics issue: if the faster process reads the PID file between mkdir and writeFileSync, it sees 'pid unknown'. Not a correctness bug — the lock exclusion is guaranteed by mkdirSync atomicity. Acceptable edge case for a diagnostic field.

postWriteReview.singleResponsibility: scripts/live-e2e/env.mjs owns environment/fingerprint/lock/cleanup; bootstrap.mjs owns corpus bootstrap/verify; runner.mjs owns CLI dispatch. Each file owns one noun phrase.
postWriteReview.boundaryPurity: CLI args parsed at boundary (print-env --mode validated, lock-probe --hold-ms validated). Root path resolved at boundary. Fingerprints parsed from JSON at boundary. All internal functions receive typed values.
postWriteReview.variantDiscrimination: tryLock returns discriminated union ({kind:'acquired'}|{kind:'held', reason}). cmdLockProbe switches on kind exhaustively. No if/elif/else on variants.
postWriteReview.escapeHatches: None. No any casts, no null assertions, no as casts.
postWriteReview.defensiveLayer: None. mkdirSync failures are caught via try/catch, not pre-checked. Fingerprint load returns null, not a conditional.
postWriteReview.helpersForOneOff: None. buildEnv/writeFingerprint/loadFingerprint/tryLock/removeE2eState are all used. bootstrap.mjs was extracted from runner.mjs to share between CLI + tests.
postWriteReview.tests: 16 focused tests for todo 2 (plus 11 preserved from todo 1). All RED→GREEN.
postWriteReview.parameterBloat: No function exceeds 3 parameters. tryLock(holdMs=0) has 1 optional param. buildEnv(root) has 1 param. fingerprintMatch has 2 params.
postWriteReview.redundantVerification: None. Cold mode calls removeE2eState() which removes the dir. No post-removal readdirSync to 'confirm'. Fingerprint write uses writeFileSync without readback.
postWriteReview.negativeNaming: None. All names are positive: buildEnv, writeFingerprint, loadFingerprint, tryLock, removeE2eState, fingerprintsMatch.
postWriteReview.loggingConventions: Runner uses console.log/console.error with structured prefix patterns (live-e2e-lock-acquired, live-e2e-lock-held, live-e2e-fingerprint-mismatch, live-e2e-root-not-bootstrapped). Follows existing project pattern.
